text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: School uniform at a theme park, woooooooo~~~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, for real!? I am so hyped right now, this is insane!!
Like, Miracle, you're literally a god!?！？

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, Helios, you're in uniform, so don't
get too carried away, okay!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Well, I get that it's fun and all, but...!
Miracle, thanks a bunch, really!
For bringing us along!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all.
I basically just got lucky getting it.

Today, I came to a theme park
along with K.S. Miracle and her friends.
"You see, during a recent run, K.S. Miracle came across a woman on the roadside who was feeling unwell and helped her, but—"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
To think that person was the amusement park owner
and gave us invitation tickets.
A delightful chain of breezes, isn't it... Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
However, are you truly sure it is all right
for us to be the ones calling forth the wind?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Of course. In fact... if anything,
I should be the one thanking you for coming.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Because... I've always wanted to thank Zephyr and the others
for everything they did last year.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for giving me this chance.
I'd be so happy if you could enjoy today to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totes, totes, totes!
We're gonna go all-out and party hard!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, you too, Lady!?
Man, I'm so glad we could make it~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
You reached out to me early,
and I had no other plans scheduled afterwards.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Early! Quick start! Exactly!
The stuff I never do, or rather, can't do!!
And the exact reason they gave me the cold shoulder yesterday!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
We got to meet today, so it's all good♡
Alrighty, let's go, let's goooo~!!
Mira-Trainer-pi, you're on chaperone duty☆
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll be watching over you, so go have fun.
Yeah, I'll be watching over you, so go have fun.

text_block_list.text: And so, K.S.Miracle and the others had so much fun playing around afterward that it blew away the year-end chill—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I kneeeew thrill rides were the way to go~~!
What about that one next!?
The drop one! The crazy dropping one!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Is this the one that drops...?! Okay, let's ride it.
I-I'll do my best...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Um, what does everyone else want to do?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. A pleasant breeze seems to be blowing over there as well...
I would love to join you.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"I'll come along too, sir!
Miracle, if Helios is dragging you around,
make sure you speak up, okay?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, it's fine. I'm just not used to it yet,
and I really want to be able to enjoy it with you...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: So, Ruby... Are you waiting down below with your Trainer this time, too?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Understood, I will do as you say.
choice_data_list: (N-now what should I talk about next...!?)

text_block_list.text: Before I knew it, I ended up talking at length with Daiichi Ruby about K.S. Miracle—practically the only topic we had in common—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I-Incredible, ssus... The bear, rabbit, and squirrel faces are all balanced exquisitely on top of each other, ssus...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Now that you mention it...
that balance really is artistic, incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah ha ha ha ha ha! Whoa, so cute!
Ban-cham and Prof Mira's reactions are adorbz too ♡
And over here—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"No way, you ate it that fast!?
Aw, I wanted to take a pic before you dug in!
A two-shot of a cute cake and a cute young lady!!"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, should I have stopped them?
I'm sorry, the thought of taking a picture didn't even cross my mind.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I believe you should focus on your meal.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Pien~! Even at a super sweet cafe, the lady's giving me the cold shoulder!

Surrounded by youthful appetites,
I held back a slight case of heartburn—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, hold on. I just realized,
aren't we, like, way too chill about this?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... D-Do you really think so?
If I don't show a bit more of a reaction, maybe it's rude...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"It varies from person to person,
so there is no need to worry over it."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Man, what a funny coincidence!
None of us mind horror stuff at all!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...No, I don't think it applies to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Ghost
text_block_list.text: GUOOOOOH--!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-san!?
I'm so sorry, I'll be right over!

Embarrassingly enough, I even had to be
guided all the way to the exit—

"That enjoyable time flew by in a flash,
and the sun began to set."
choice_data_list: Well then, I'll go buy some food and drinks.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Right on! Miracle, you guys
save a spot for the parade here, please!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I'll be waiting, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'll go buy some crazy-good churros or somethingâ
Later!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yeah, later. .........

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ? ...Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no. It just felt kind of surreal, and made me a little happy.
...To think I could be in a place like this with you.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
True, I reached out to you early so you could clear your schedule, but...
to be honest, I thought you'd turn me down.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ruby, thank you for coming.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: No, I was the one who asked you out.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Besides, I had my own subtle motives as well.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: An ulterior motive?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Wondering who should truly be reflected in those eyes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Just who is the opponent
you should compete against for "fastest"—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I just wanted to etch it into my memory, if only a little.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ruby...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"You have stayed ahead of me many times.
However—"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Even now, I am here,
and I continue to run.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Chasing the future beyond that.
Pursuing that splendid glory.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
The crimson radiance shall not dim.
The cherry-blossom petals, the azure miracle—
all will inevitably be transcended—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I shall claim the title of "fastest of our era."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Please, prepare yourself.

Afterward. I met up with K.S. Miracle and the others,
and we were enjoying the parade, the final highlight of the day, but—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh... Y-Yes?

Wondering why she looked so flustered, I asked her.
Even though such a spectacular parade was unfolding right before our eyes—
choice_data_list: Aren't you looking everywhere except where you should be?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah... No, umm.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...I kind of had it hammered home to me.

In a voice almost drowned out by the clamor,
that was all she answered.
